prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, shallow depth-of-field photograph of a black-and-white ink illustration in an open book. The illustration features a detailed, realistic adult elephant with long, curved tusks, standing among tall grasses. The elephant is drawn with expressive linework, emphasizing the texture of its skin and the folds of its trunk and ears. To the right, partially visible, are the heads of two smaller elephants, suggesting a family group. The background is the off-white, slightly textured paper of the book, with faint, out-of-focus printed text visible along the left edge. The lighting is soft and natural, casting gentle shadows that enhance the three-dimensional quality of the ink drawing. The overall mood is calm and contemplative, with a focus on the artistry and detail of the illustration, evoking the feel of a vintage naturalist’s field guide.
